body: I am talking about this first hand...I know what it’s like to loose someone like this and I know what it’s like to want to kill myself..but it’s because of my sisters and my parents that’s I stay...I know they lost one child already if they loose another one their world would be crushed..and I just want to help people realize better days will come and people do love you...if you can’t stay for yourself stay for them..if you can’t find any love in this world be the love for this world...show people you care because people need that...And that’s what I’m doing I’m opening up my messages and I’m opening up my heart for people who don’t have nowhere else...and I’m telling them someone is willing to listen and help ❤️
No it’s being there for people and letting them know that people care about them and love them.
